summary: {person} brings the employer's own letter showing time worked past the regular shift.
realLife: A former taco shop employee gave Denver Labor an employer letter listing overtime, prompting a request for payroll covering other workers.
gates: A wage dispute includes a written statement of hours from the employer.
weights: A discrepancy with the pay record makes the letter more relevant.
inGame: needs: the employer's letter, the time sheet and the paid overtime.

turns.what: The letter agrees with the payment.
turns.pulledBy: Payroll shows the correct overtime premium.
turns.writesBack: The comparison resolves the disputed shift.

turns.what: The letter covers one pay period.
turns.pulledBy: The complaint spans several pay periods.
turns.writesBack: Investigators request the other time sheets.
